patch_description: Replace the global-radius scaling certification with a fixed-center linear program.  For any candidate center configuration, the radii subproblem is linear: each radius is capped by its nearest wall, and every pair imposes `r_i + r_j <= distance(i,j)`.  The existing common scaling discards uneven-radius improvements whenever one nearly active constraint has optimizer roundoff.  Solving this small 26-variable LP recovers the best feasible unequal radii for the optimized centers, especially improving boundary-layer configurations.  A small margin makes the returned packing strictly valid.
